sponsored.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta not to exceed 6%.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Gardiner to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Gardiner, in the county of Ulster, to impose a hotel and motel tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the county of Greene.

sponsored.t: Provides exceptions to the three-year prohibition of employment with the New York state gaming commission
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Provides exceptions to the three-year prohibition of employment with the New York state gaming commission; excludes starters from the three-year prohibition; allows the commission to provide exceptions during the hiring process.

sponsored.t: Includes the county of Sullivan within the definition of a designated community
sponsored.sum: Includes the county of Sullivan within the definition of a designated community for purposes of community preservation funds.

sponsored.t: Establishes a community housing fund in the town of Rochester, county of Ulster
sponsored.sum: Establishes a community housing fund in the town of Rochester, county of Ulster, to provide housing opportunities for its residents.
sponsored.fis: No fiscal impact on the state. The fund is financed through the supple- mental real estate transfer tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the county of Schoharie.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of the department of civil service to reinstate Daniel Montalto on the eligible civil service list for employment as a police officer in the town of Shawangunk
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Daniel Montalto to take the competitive civil service exam for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Shawangunk.
sponsored.fis: The salary of a police officer for the town.

sponsored.t: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system to Jason T McGlone
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Hancock to Jason T McGlone.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of professional misconduct
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of professional misconduct to include refusing to provide professional services to a person referred for treatment by a United States Department of Veterans Affairs facility or provider because such person declines elective services during the course of treatment.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lieutenant Roland "The Gator" Ward
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in Sullivan county to Lieutenant Roland "The Gator" Ward.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring state agencies to offer an option to speak to a live agency representative
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to offer an option for a member of the public to speak to a live agency representative when contacting such agency.

sponsored.t: Requires the completion of animal cruelty prevention workshops by certain persons
sponsored.sum: Requires the completion of animal cruelty prevention workshops by any person who purchases, acquires or initiates a farm operation on which horses and/or cows are kept.

sponsored.t: Establishes the rural teacher education loan repayment program in the education department
sponsored.sum: Establishes the rural teacher education loan repayment program in the education department which provides payment for the undergraduate and graduate education loans of teachers in rural school districts who agree to teach in rural areas for at least 5 years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of vehicles on approach of authorized emergency vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires drivers to create a center rescue lane on approach of authorized emergency vehicles.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive participation in the New York State and Local Employees' Retirement System to the Rockland Central School District
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive participation in the New York State and Local Employees' Retirement System to the Rockland Central School District; deems such school district to have been a participating employer beginning on July 1, 2025 and relates to contributions made by eligible employees on and after July 1, 2025.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of the department of civil service to reinstate John Raftery on the eligible civil service list for employment as a police officer in the town of Shawangunk
sponsored.sum: Authorizes John Raftery to take the competitive civil service exam for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Shawangunk.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "BEAMS" act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "brightness emission analysis for motorist safety (BEAMS) act" which requires the department of transportation with participating institutions conduct a study on LED headlights.
sponsored.fis: Costs to the department of transportation, the governor's traffic safety committee, the state university of New York and the city university of New York to conduct such study and develop a report on their findings.

sponsored.t: Provides for statewide uniformity of vehicle inspection fees
sponsored.sum: Requires that maximum fees to be charged by an official inspection station are uniformly applicable statewide.

sponsored.t: Relates to state police retirement service credit for Michael V. Layman
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael V. Layman to receive state police retirement credit for services performed as a SUNY police officer.
sponsored.fis: This bill would grant Michael V. Layman, a retiree of the New York State and Local Police and Fire Retirement System and former New York State Police officer, additional service creditable for time worked as a university police officer. If this bill is enacted during the 2026 Legislative Session, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $133,000 which will be borne by the State of New York as a one-time payment. This estimate assumes that payment will be made on March 1, 2027. Summary of relevant resources: Membership data as of March 31, 2025 was used in measuring the impact of the proposed change, the same data used in the April 1, 2025 actuarial valuation. Distributions and other statistics can be found in the 2025 Report of the Actuary and the 2025 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report. The actuarial assumptions and methods used are described in the 2024 Annual…

sponsored.t: Relates to the inspection of meters and other apparatus used for regulating and supplying gas or electricity by the division of weights and measures
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of weights and measures to inspect meters and other apparatus used for regulating and supplying gas or electricity to verify that such apparatus are properly maintained and calibrated.

sponsored.t: Relates to termination of service, deferred payment plans and quarterly billing
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of days between the sending of a notice of termination by a utility corporation and the actual date of termination of service; increases the age of residents in the home to 21 from 18 for purposes of special procedures for terminations; decreases the amount required for a downpayment on an arrears on utility bills; lowers the age of customers to whom a utility company must offer quarterly billing from 62 to 55.

sponsored.t: Increases the time certain parties have to submit a notice of intent to be a party to the certification proceedings for the siting of major utility transmission facilities
sponsored.sum: Increases the time certain parties have to submit a notice of intent to be a party to the certification proceedings for the siting of major utility transmission facilities from thirty days to forty-five days.

sponsored.t: Allows customers of a utility to call for an independent audit of the utility's records
sponsored.sum: Allows 100 of more current customers of a utility to demand that the public service commission perform an audit of a public utility that has knowingly failed or neglected to obey the law or comply with its legal obligations.

sponsored.t: Relates to complaint handling procedures
sponsored.sum: Modifies complaint handling procedures for utility customers to provide for better communication and clarity for such customers.

sponsored.t: Requires that gas and electric corporations provide in-person customer service representatives and maintain a publicly accessible outage and emergency tracking website
sponsored.sum: Requires that gas and electric corporations provide in-person customer service representatives and maintain a publicly accessible outage and emergency tracking website.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing utility rate increase transparency
sponsored.sum: Increases utility rate increase transparency for consumers by requiring additional information be made accessible to the public regarding fuel cost increases and increases in rates or charges.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring detailed billing for utilities and requiring utility providers to attend local municipal meetings to present proposed rate or charge increases
sponsored.sum: Requires detailed billing for utilities and requiring utility providers to attend local municipal meetings to present proposed rate or charge increases.

sponsored.t: Establishes the reclaimed asphalt pavement pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the reclaimed asphalt pavement pilot program for the purpose of utilization of reclaimed asphalt pavement in the construction or improvement of state and municipal highways or bridges.
sponsored.fis: Costs to the Department of Transportation to establish and report on the reclaimed asphalt pavement pilot program.

sponsored.t: Provides a religious exemption for the requirement to have a photograph taken for a driver's license or learner's permit
sponsored.sum: Provides a religious exemption for the requirement to have a photograph taken for a driver's license or learner's permit.

sponsored.t: Elevates assault of a code enforcement official to the class D felony of assault in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Elevates assault of a code enforcement official in the second degree to a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Establishes the task force on daylight saving time
sponsored.sum: Establishes the task force on daylight saving time to study the effects of New York state opting out of daylight saving time.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a state income tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Provides a state income tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers who have qualifying service in the taxable year for which such exemption is sought.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. However, it is anticipated that this loss of income tax revenue to the State of New York would be minimal compared to the expense of switching to all-paid service if volunteer membership contin- ues to decline.

sponsored.t: Relates to reserve funds to ensure compliance with the tax cap in future school years
sponsored.sum: Authorizes school districts with low combined wealth ratios to establish a reserve fund to ensure compliance with the tax cap in future school years.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing an income tax credit for retired disabled police officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a $750 income tax credit for retired disabled police officers.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalty for rape in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalty for rape in the first degree from a class B felony to an class A-II felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to firearms; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to firearms; authorizes the transfer of certain weapons from an estate to an immediate member of the decedent's family; relates to reports of substantial risk or threat of harm by mental health professionals.

sponsored.t: Repeals provision of law prohibiting the possession of certain large capacity ammunition feeding devices and the exemption of certain ammunition feeding devices at firing ranges; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions of law prohibiting the possession of certain large capacity ammunition feeding devices and the exemption of certain ammunition feeding devices at firing ranges.

sponsored.t: Eliminates additional application fees and annual fees for special license plates issued to veterans of the armed forces of the United States
sponsored.sum: Eliminates additional application fees and annual fees for special license plates issued to veterans of the armed forces of the United States.

sponsored.t: Provides for statewide video arraignments
sponsored.sum: Provides that the court may, in its discretion, dispense with the defendant's personal appearance at an arraignment and conduct an electronic arraignment.

sponsored.t: Relates to a school resource officer program
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a school resource officer program to permit the employment of retired law enforcement officers and provide grants to school districts and non-public schools for such purpose.
sponsored.fis: This bill will establish a new state education grant program, the cost of which will depend upon the number of schools hire school resource officers. This program would establish a grant formula, providing $50,000 for every district that hires a single school resource officer, or a multiple of $20,000 for multiple hires.

sponsored.t: Relates to membership on the state board of parole
sponsored.sum: Requires the state board of parole to include at least one member who is or was a member of law enforcement and at least one member who is a crime victim or crime victim's representative.

sponsored.t: Relates to a tax credit for employment of an individual who has successfully completed a judicial diversion substance abuse treatment program or graduated from drug court
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for employment of an individual who has successfully completed a judicial diversion substance abuse treatment program or graduated from drug court.

sponsored.t: Relates to broadband mapping and expansion of such service
sponsored.sum: Requires the Empire State Development corporation's broadband program office to assist in the provision and expansion of broadband internet access service and to address inequities in the availability of such service.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a school resource officer working group; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Creates a school resource officer working group to study appropriate standards and training for a person to serve as a school resource officer; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated harassment by the display of symbols of Nazi Germany
sponsored.sum: Provides that the display of symbols of Nazi Germany in a public location in a manner that is likely to cause another person to feel harassed, annoyed, threatened or alarmed, or to incite violence, shall be aggravated harassment.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of education of the state of New York to conduct a study on the sufficiency of current education aid apportionment formulas and make recommendations for improvements to such formulas
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education of the state of New York to conduct a study on the sufficiency of current education aid apportionment formulas, make recommendations for improvements to such formulas and deliver a report of such findings and recommendations and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Extends the benefits of the STAR program to small businesses
sponsored.sum: Relates to extending the benefits of the STAR program to small businesses; defines small business as a business which employs one hundred persons or less.

sponsored.t: Gives state income tax credit to volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance corps in good standing up to $2500
sponsored.sum: Gives state income tax credit to volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance corps in good standing up to $2500; must be in good standing for a minimum of five years and maintain continued eligibility.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "EmpowerED Act: Empowering students and enhancing educational opportunities in New York"
sponsored.sum: Establishes interregional enrollment of students taking classes in multiple school districts (Part A); allows students who are enrolled in and taking classes in multiple school districts to receive cooperative and individualized educational services (Part B).

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing student loan repayment accounts
sponsored.sum: Establishes student loan repayment accounts; authorizes employers to establish student loan repayment accounts and provide matching funds up to $5000 a year; establishes tax deductions for participating employers.
sponsored.fis: The program shall not exceed $70 million annually.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing that all court clerks of the unified court system shall be designated as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Provides that all court clerks of the unified court system shall be designated as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting registered security guards in a hospital or health care facility from assault; class D felony
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting registered security guards in a hospital or health care facility from assault; makes such assault a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Establishes an adopt-a-rural cemetery program
sponsored.sum: Directs the secretary of state to develop and implement an adopt-a-rural-cemetery program for the purposes of improving, repairing, and maintaining cemeteries in rural communities which are registered with and overseen by the division of cemeteries; allows municipalities to opt in to the program.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring internet service providers to charge a residential rate to emergency service organizations
sponsored.sum: Requires internet service providers to charge a residential rate to emergency service organizations; creates a new article for the regulation of internet service providers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a hunting mentorship program
sponsored.sum: Allows a person who is at least ten years of age to hunt small game, fowl, deer or bear during applicable seasons without obtaining a hunting license or hunter's education course certification and to possess or control a firearm if the person is within arm's reach of a qualified hunting mentor.

sponsored.t: Relates to purchases of ammunition
sponsored.sum: Permits those licensed to carry or possess a pistol or revolver or to purchase or take possession of a semi-automatic rifle or licensed to hunt wildlife to purchase or take possession of ammunition without requiring contacting the statewide license and record database.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a real property tax exemption for certain persons sixty years of age or over
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax exemption for persons sixty years of age or over with an annual household income not exceeding $100,000; directs the state to reimburse municipalities for lost revenues.

sponsored.t: Relates to state aid for emergency medical services
sponsored.sum: Classifies emergency medical services as essential services for the purposes of state aid.

sponsored.t: Prohibits level 2 and 3 sex offenders from residing within 1,500 feet of their victim or school grounds; also prohibits such offenders from attending school activities
sponsored.sum: Prohibits level 2 and 3 sex offenders from residing within 1,500 feet of their victim or school grounds; prohibits such offenders from attending or participating in school sponsored activities.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing contractual requirements for logging agreements
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions to protect property owners from timber theft; establishes contractual requirements for logging agreements.

sponsored.t: Authorizes police officers the ability to request a person who is driving a motor vehicle with tinted windows roll down all windows to protect such officer's health or safety
sponsored.sum: Authorizes police officers the ability to request a person who is driving a motor vehicle with tinted windows roll down all windows to protect such officer's health or safety; defines "tinted windows".

sponsored.t: Provides that certified handicapped individuals may use an ATV on public land for transportation purposes only, during the hunting season
sponsored.sum: Provides that certified handicapped individuals may use an ATV on public land for transportation purposes only, during the hunting season.

sponsored.t: Provides tax credits equal to the cost of the issuance of fishing and hunting licenses to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Provides tax credits equal to the cost of the issuance of fishing and hunting licenses to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers.

sponsored.t: Provides for the establishment of a method for determining the lowest responsible bidder when negotiating state contracts
sponsored.sum: Provides for the establishment of a method for determining the lowest responsible bidder when negotiating state contracts that would incorporate quantifiable fiscal benefits.
sponsored.fis: This legislation would result in savings to the state, increased revenue to the state, and the creation of tax revenue producing jobs.

sponsored.t: Relates to bail for certain offenses involving the sale or possession with intent to sell of a controlled substance or a synthetic opioid
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of bail for certain offenses involving the sale or possession with intent to sell of a controlled substance or a synthetic opioid.

sponsored.t: Provides for transportation after 4pm by school districts in Sullivan county
sponsored.sum: Requires transportation after 4pm be provided for certain students by school districts in Sullivan county.

sponsored.t: Relates to falconry
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of DEC to remove peregrine falcons from the endangered species list and to promulgate regulations for their use in falconry.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Bloomingburg to enter into a contract to sell or pledge as collateral for a loan some or all of the delinquent liens held by such city to a private party or engage a private party
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Bloomingburg to enter into a contract to sell or pledge as collateral for a loan some or all of the delinquent liens held by such city to a private party or engage a private party.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Trooper Jill E. Mattice
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Morris, county of Otsego, to Trooper Jill E. Mattice.

sponsored.t: Authorizes bail for principals charged with aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Authorizes bail for principals charged with aggravated cruelty to animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing bail and pre-trial detention for arson felonies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes bail and pre-trial detention for all arson felonies.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for Otsego county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for Otsego county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the authority for the impose an additional mortgage recording tax in Otsego county
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority for the county of Otsego to impose an additional mortgage recording tax.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for additional sales and use tax for Schoharie county
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for additional sales and use tax for Schoharie county.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for the county of Schoharie to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for the county of Schoharie to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property.

sponsored.t: Extends the mortgage recording tax for Chenango county and relates to the depositing of mortgage recording tax funds into the general fund of the county of Chenango
sponsored.sum: Extends the mortgage recording tax for Chenango county; relates to the depositing of mortgage recording tax funds into the general fund of the county of Chenango.

sponsored.t: Extends authorization to impose certain taxes in the county of Sullivan
sponsored.sum: Extends authorization to impose certain taxes in the county of Sullivan.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Delaware to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Delaware to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Extends the additional one percent sales and use tax for Chenango county
sponsored.sum: Extends the additional one percent sales and use tax for Chenango county.

sponsored.t: Relates to bail for certain offenses involving threats of mass harm against a school district, school, school staff or a student
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of bail for certain offenses involving threats of mass harm against a school district, school, school staff or a student.
